model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the negative log probability of per-specialty terms for different fine-tuned models. The horizontal axis contains the categories of specialty terms, labeled as Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, in that order, with no apparent scale or sorting. The vertical axis represents the negative log probability, labeled with values ranging from -27 to -22, with a linear scale and tick labels at regular intervals. Each category has a set of grouped bars, with each bar representing a model fine-tuned on a specific specialty, distinguished by color: blue for Mistralv0.2-Base, and shades of orange and brown for the other specialties. The approximate values for the bars range from -22 to -26.5, with the blue bars generally having lower values than the others. The bars within each group are visually arranged side-by-side, with no apparent sorting or emphasis.
